The Forbidden Playground hidden within a Kamihama hotel: "Casino Magica."
■ 2F: Elegant Muse
[The Dominion of Teasing and the Lounge of Elegance]
A secluded second stratum, separated from the clamor of the first floor by a heavy, soundproof door.
This is a realm of silence and order, where only the chosen are permitted to tread.
The "purity" of the floor below is cast aside here; only those who seize victory are granted the "privilege" of cupping the exposed, forbidden fruits in their palms.

In this world, everything is settled with grace, yet with a cruelty that liquidates all into "value" amidst the frenzied night.
And yet, from the top of the staircase nestled in the floor's shadows, a scent begins to leak—a cloyingly sweet, humid "heat of depravity," utterly alien to the nobility of this lounge——.
